events.body:
## Context

`scripts/build_showcase.py` (about L395) strips `[ ]`/`[x]` lines with a lowercase-only class, while `extract_category` uses `[ xX]`. The 200-character truncation and code-fence stripping are untested.

## What to do

1. Change the class to `[ xX]`.
2. Add tests for uppercase X, a fenced description, and a 250-character description (197 chars + "…").

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Three new tests
- [ ] Suite passes

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-design-contest
```
